fields.label: Sections
fields.name: sections
fields.instructions: The page is built from these, in order. Each one becomes a node in the sidebar nav tree.

sub_fields.label: Variant
sub_fields.name: variant
sub_fields.instructions: Home is the animated headline. Case sits above a MetaBlock. Simple is everything else.

sub_fields.label: Headline lead
sub_fields.name: headline_lead
sub_fields.instructions: Large type. Line breaks are meaningful.
sub_fields.placeholder: Design engineer building the sites you see

sub_fields.label: Headline tail
sub_fields.name: headline_tail
sub_fields.instructions: The second line, set in mono.

sub_fields.label: Highlighted words
sub_fields.name: headline_highlight
sub_fields.instructions: Must appear inside the headline tail exactly. These words are set in black and only become readable once the yellow box wipes in behind them.

sub_fields.label: Paragraph
sub_fields.name: paragraph
sub_fields.instructions: Set in the large paragraph style.

sub_fields.label: Table name
sub_fields.name: table_name
sub_fields.instructions: The label on the tab above the table.

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: table_columns
sub_fields.instructions: One per column. Only shown as a header row when Show headers is on.

sub_fields.label: Rows
sub_fields.name: table_rows
sub_fields.instructions: One row per line of the table. Add a cell for each column.

sub_fields.label: Kicker
sub_fields.name: kicker
sub_fields.instructions: Mono caps above the title.

sub_fields.label: Media side
sub_fields.name: media_side
sub_fields.instructions: Which half of the grid the media takes.

sub_fields.label: CTA label
sub_fields.name: cta_label
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty for no CTA.

sub_fields.label: CTA link
sub_fields.name: cta_link
sub_fields.instructions: An in-page anchor, e.g. #text-section-2. Scrolls to that section.

sub_fields.label: Media
sub_fields.name: media
sub_fields.instructions: Image or mp4.

sub_fields.label: Kicker
sub_fields.name: kicker
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Left empty, no kicker renders -- there is no fallback text.

sub_fields.label: Emphasis line
sub_fields.name: emphasis_line
sub_fields.instructions: Set in yellow. Roughly one per page, so it keeps its weight.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter where the line should break.

sub_fields.label: Paragraphs
sub_fields.name: paragraphs
sub_fields.instructions: The body. One paragraph per row.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: paragraph_text
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter for a line break.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter where the line should break.

sub_fields.label: Copy blocks
sub_fields.name: copy_blocks
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave the label empty for plain prose; fill it for a mono-labelled block.

sub_fields.label: List items
sub_fields.name: list_items
sub_fields.instructions: Optional bulleted list under the copy blocks.

sub_fields.label: Video
sub_fields.name: media_video
sub_fields.instructions: mp4. Renders muted and looped.

sub_fields.label: Video poster
sub_fields.name: media_video_poster
sub_fields.instructions: Shown before the video loads, and in place of it under reduced motion.

sub_fields.label: Table name
sub_fields.name: table_name
sub_fields.instructions: The label on the tab above the table.

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: table_columns
sub_fields.instructions: One per column.

sub_fields.label: Rows
sub_fields.name: table_rows
sub_fields.instructions: One row per line. Add a cell for each column.

sub_fields.label: Media
sub_fields.name: media
sub_fields.instructions: Image or mp4.

sub_fields.label: Browser frame
sub_fields.name: frame
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap in browser chrome.

sub_fields.label: Zoom lens
sub_fields.name: zoom_lens
sub_fields.instructions: Hover magnifier. Automatically off on touch and under reduced motion.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter where the line should break.

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter where the line should break.

sub_fields.label: Media
sub_fields.name: card_media
sub_fields.instructions: Image or mp4. Video renders muted and looped.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter where the line should break.

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Press Enter where the line should break.

sub_fields.label: Show in a panel
sub_fields.name: in_panel
sub_fields.instructions: Renders the section inside a tab and bordered panel, like the tables. The kicker becomes the tab label and no longer shows above the heading, so give this section a kicker when you turn this on.

sub_fields.label: Pin the copy while the list scrolls
sub_fields.name: pinned
sub_fields.instructions: Puts the heading and intro in a narrow column that holds still while the list scrolls past it, highlighting each item as you reach it. The section media is hidden when this is on -- the two want the same columns.

sub_fields.label: Media
sub_fields.name: media
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Image or mp4, video renders muted and looped. Added, it sits left across half the width and the numbered list moves right. Left empty, the list runs full width.

sub_fields.label: Items
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: Numbered automatically as 01., 02. and so on.

sub_fields.label: Artifact
sub_fields.name: item_media
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. The artifact for this step. Image or mp4.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: The full statement. In the scroll variant it splits into two halves that converge.
sub_fields.placeholder: The content model is a user interface, the editor is the user.

sub_fields.label: Highlighted phrases
sub_fields.name: highlight_phrases
sub_fields.instructions: Each must appear in the quote exactly. Rendered as yellow mono highlight boxes.

sub_fields.label: Next case study
sub_fields.name: next_ref
sub_fields.instructions: The kicker composes itself as "NEXT CASE STUDY · {name}".

sub_fields.label: Title override
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Falls back to the referenced entry's card summary.

sub_fields.label: Media override
sub_fields.name: media
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Falls back to the referenced entry's card media.

sub_fields.label: Tabs
sub_fields.name: tabs
sub_fields.instructions: One row per tab. Cards are pulled from the chosen post type, filtered on "On Home" and ordered by sort order.

sub_fields.label: Count
sub_fields.name: count_display
sub_fields.instructions: Shown in the chip.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: The tab title above the table.

sub_fields.label: Count
sub_fields.name: count_display
sub_fields.instructions: Evergreen, does not track the row count.

sub_fields.label: Rows
sub_fields.name: rows
sub_fields.instructions: Drag order is the display order within a year. Years sort descending.

sub_fields.label: Role
sub_fields.name: role
sub_fields.instructions: Rendered joined with " + " in the order listed here, so Design + build + ops always reads the same way.

sub_fields.label: Stack
sub_fields.name: stack
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for design-only rows. Rendered joined with " · " in the order listed here, so the CMS always precedes the framework and GSAP always comes last.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: External URL, or an internal path such as /case-studies/ascaya.

sub_fields.label: Collaboration
sub_fields.name: is_collaboration
sub_fields.instructions: Adds the star beside the site name.

sub_fields.label: Collaborator
sub_fields.name: collaborator
sub_fields.instructions: Supplies the star colour and the legend entry.

sub_fields.label: Thumbnail
sub_fields.name: thumb
sub_fields.instructions: Optional hover peek. Image or mp4.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: The line under the table. The collaborator legend is generated separately from the rows above.
sub_fields.placeholder: Every build includes the content modeling: custom post types, field architecture (ACF), and the editor experience.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Tab title above the panel.

sub_fields.label: Count display
sub_fields.name: count_display
sub_fields.instructions: The chip on the tab, e.g. 14 years.

sub_fields.label: Entries
sub_fields.name: entries
sub_fields.instructions: Oldest first. Entries alternate sides automatically.

sub_fields.label: Date
sub_fields.name: entry_date
sub_fields.instructions: Text, not a date: 2013-2015 is valid.

sub_fields.label: Gallery
sub_fields.name: entry_gallery
sub_fields.instructions: The entry's swipeable media, in the order shown. Images or mp4. When this has items it replaces Media entirely; Media is only read while this is empty.

sub_fields.label: Body
sub_fields.name: entry_body
sub_fields.instructions: One paragraph per line.

sub_fields.label: Notes
sub_fields.name: notes
sub_fields.instructions: Between 1 and 3 stickies. The whole sticky is clickable.

sub_fields.label: Question
sub_fields.name: question
sub_fields.placeholder: Curious how all of this gets built?

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link_url
sub_fields.instructions: Internal paths are fine, e.g. /process.
